design_standard.accessibility: Readable at phone width; strong typography, 4-7 word cover hook maximum, contrast checked
design_standard.composition: 1 bold useful visual demonstration + small Socialora brand signature; no giant logo or large generic marketing button
design_standard.variety: Rotate editorial typography, illustration, useful comparison, original mockup, 3-step diagram, calendar, data explainer, device preview. Use distinctive palette and layout for each topic; do not output identical purple template pins.
design_standard.creative_tests: Evaluate human clarity in 2 seconds: question, actual visual answer, genuine reason to click. If graphic or copy fails, skip rather than publish filler.
design_standard.language: Natural human English, informative rather than promotional; no guaranteed results, invented followers/comments, vague inspiration, heavy hashtags or keyword stuffing
design_standard.truth: Do not imply example UI, simulated numbers, tool capabilities or results are real; do not claim platform endorsement.
design_standard.link: Link directly to relevant existing free-tool page and preserve unique UTM; check website link resolves.
design_standard.posting: Before each Pin, verify previous 24h topic/board and actual Pinterest IDs. Avoid duplicate URLs in same day when possible. New account: prioritize fresh ideas over sheer volume.
